text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. ♪ I'm so<n>deeply moved.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You wished me a happy birthday right<n>here at
Tracen Academy instead of<n>waiting for the Mejiro
family party.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. We both got into the<n>academy, and now
we run here<n>together. It's pretty amazing to think
about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We've celebrated a lot of birthdays<n>and run over
countless tracks<n>together. I hope we stay this close
forever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: In that case, there's one more thingyou could do to make that happen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Remember? You always used to wear<n>those big,
soft, fluffy dresses to all<n>the parties.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's only because I was told to<n>dress up!
Those don't look good on<n>me at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying? That's not true<n>in the least. I
would simply love to<n>celebrate with you looking so
lovely<n>again. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...How unfair. I can't refuse since it's<n>your
birthday... Fine... but only for a<n>little, okay?
